definitions.gloss: bargain item; sale item; special-offer product
definitions.explanation: A product being sold at a reduced price during a special sale or promotion. Composed of {特売|とくばい} (special sale) + {品|ひん} (item).

examples.japanese: {特売品|とくばいひん}を{買|か}いに{行|い}く。
examples.english: I'm going to buy sale items.

examples.japanese: スーパーの{特売品|とくばいひん}はすぐに{売|う}り{切|き}れる。
examples.english: The sale items at the supermarket sell out quickly.

examples.japanese: チラシに{載|の}っている{特売品|とくばいひん}を{目当|めあ}てに{朝|あさ}{早|はや}くから{並|なら}んでいる{人|ひと}がいた。
examples.english: There were people lining up from early morning, hoping to get the sale items advertised in the flyer.

notes:
USAGE:
{特売品|とくばいひん} is commonly seen in supermarkets, department stores, and electronics shops. Items are often advertised in チラシ (flyers) or on {店頭|てんとう} (in-store) displays. The compound breaks down as {特売|とくばい} (special sale) + {品|ひん} (item/goods).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {特売品|とくばいひん}コーナー (bargain section)
- {特売品|とくばいひん}を{狙|ねら}う (go after sale items)
- {本日|ほんじつ}の{特売品|とくばいひん} (today's specials)

RELATED WORDS:
- {特売|とくばい} is the sale event itself.
- {目玉商品|めだましょうひん} refers to a featured sale item used as a draw.
- {割引|わりびき} means discount.
